title: Mrežna sigurnost
summary: OSI/TCP-IP, IPv4/IPv6, IPSec/TLS/SSH, višeslojni i konvergirani protokoli, segmentacija i mikrosegmentacija, bežične i celularne mreže, SDN/SD-WAN/VPC, NAC, prenosni mediji i sigurni kanali (glas, video, udaljeni pristup, treće strane).
summary_en: OSI/TCP-IP, IPv4/IPv6, IPSec/TLS/SSH, multilayer and converged protocols, segmentation and microsegmentation, wireless and cellular networks, SDN/SD-WAN/VPC, NAC, transmission media and secure communication channels (voice, video, remote access, third parties).
